 Graham Weaver – People-Driven Private Equity at Alpine (EP.391) Jun 10, 2024

 Graham Weaver is the managing partner of
Alpine Investors, a $17 billion people-driven private equity firm
that invests in software and services businesses. Graham founded
Alpine on the belief that exceptional people create exceptional
businesses. Alpine’s PeopleFirst approach includes hiring,
training, and placing an army of CEOs in its portfolio companies.
The strategy has led Alpine to be recognized by Prequin as the most
consistent top-performing private equity fund manager. 

Our conversation covers Graham’s early interest in self-help, his
path to private equity, and launch of Alpine in 2001. We discuss
his early mistakes, discovery of Alpine’s PeopleFirst approach, and
the firm’s playbook focused on CEOs and M&A at portfolio
companies. We close with Graham’s thoughts on teaching and
enlightenment.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
